title: [ . ] i'm not a dot
author: Hempelson Tamsova
rules:
While setting this puzzle i came across a similar piece from 6 years ago by Phistomefel. It uses substantially the same logic, but i figured it would be different enough to publish it anyway. Although the original has quite a number of solves this might be new to someone and at least for my way of solving both puzzles they were differing to some extent. Therefore you should not necessarilly presume a 1:1 fashion of number distribution. Conceivably, due to the greater number of "given" digits it may be more approachable, so perhaps it could be 2* aswell.

solve with SudokuPad

Normal Sudoku rules apply.

Any green shaded cell contains the same digit.

A small white square:

- with a digit in it indicates the appearance of that digit in the surrounding cells.

- with a "greater than" [ > ] symbol in it means the digit on the open side is larger than the digit it points at.

Digits seperated by a white dot are consecutive. Digits seperated by a black dot are in a 1:2 relationship.
Every possible dot is given (for clarification: there are no white- nor black dot relationships at all).
solutionCode: the diagonal (top left corner to bottom right, 9 digits, no spaces inbetween)
